new_today.title_zh: 韩国五大商业银行首次同时被黑客攻击，其中三家发生客户信息泄露
new_today.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 3 日消息，据韩联社报道，韩国五大商业银行均遭疑似由人工智能驱动的黑客攻击， 其中三家发生客户信息泄露 。五大银行同时遇袭，在韩国金融业尚属首次。 据韩国金融部门 2 日消息，继新韩银行之后，KB 国民银行和韩亚银行也遭到疑似由 AI 驱动的黑客攻击，造成客户信息泄露。BNK 釜山银行因黑客攻击，导致 11 名外包员工的个人信息外泄。 KB 国民银行当天表示，119 名客户的信息因黑客攻击被泄露，包括姓名、电话号码、地址、经加密处理的身份证号码等，每位客户被泄露的信息各不相同。IT之家获悉， 此次黑客攻击对象是职员专用移动办公支持系统 ，与网银、手机银行等客户的金融交易无关。 韩亚银行也表示，因遭到黑客入侵，89 名客户的信息被泄露，具体包括身份证号码、姓名、地址、邮箱、电话号码、工作单位等。据悉， 此次事件系外部黑客非法访问其业务支持系统（ODS）所致 。该系统与网银

dropped.title: 青年养老院火了两年，这门“躺平生意”怎么样了？

dropped.summary_zh: 今年国庆，年轻人的假期依旧很忙。 有人提前一个月抢机票、订酒店，有人请3休13，拿到打工人“大结果”；也有人反过来，寻找一个什么都不用安排的地方：不赶早班机、不做攻略，睡到自然醒，有饭吃，有人聊天，想出门就去附近转一圈，不想动就在院子里坐一天。 这种需求，让两年前爆火的“青年养老院”又有了新的讨论空间。 2024年前后，“青年养老院”开始集中出现在社交平台。月租一两千元、包吃包住、种菜钓鱼、喝茶晒太阳，再配上一条“45岁以下才能入住”的规则， “年轻人提前退休”迅速成为流量密码。 两年之后，这个多少带有玩笑意味的 概念并没有完全消失 。仍有民宿以“青年养老”为核心卖点，主打包三餐、安排周边路线和集体活动； 只是，当 “ 提前退休 ”“ 躺平几天 ” 的新鲜感褪去，问题也变得更加现实：靠 “ 躺 平 ” 吸引来的流量，又能不能养活一家青年养老院？而当第一轮概念热潮过去，这类项目如今又发展到了

dropped.title: CytoVI: deep generative modeling of antibody-based single cell data.
dropped.title_zh: CytoVI：基于抗体的单细胞数据的深度生成建模。
dropped.summary_zh: 基于抗体的单细胞技术，如流式细胞术、质谱流式细胞术和CITE-seq，已广泛用于临床诊断和基础研究；然而，其分析因技术噪声、批次效应、平台差异和受限抗体面板而变得复杂。在这里，我们提出CytoVI，一种概率生成模型，用于对基于抗体的单细胞数据进行统计严谨的统一分析。CytoVI在单一概率模型中生成有信息量的细胞嵌入、填补缺失测量、执行差异蛋白表达测试并自动化细胞注释。我们将CytoVI应用于构建跨越350种蛋白的整合B细胞成熟图谱，并识别出与免疫球蛋白类别转换相关的蛋白。在一个通过流式细胞术和CITE-seq分析的B细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤患者队列中，CytoVI揭示了疾病相关T细胞状态。CytoVI可作为开源软件在scvi-tools.org获取。

extra.description: Antibody-based single-cell technologies, such as flow cytometry, mass cytometry and CITE-seq, have become widely used in clinical diagnostics and basic research; however, their analysis is complicated by technical noise, batch effects, platform differences and restricted antibody panels. Here we present CytoVI, a probabilistic generative model for statistically rigorous unified analysis of antibody-based single-cell data. CytoVI generates informative cell embeddings, imputes missing measurements, performs differential protein expression testing and automates annotation of cells in a single probabilistic model. We applied CytoVI to build an integrated B cell maturation atlas spanning 350 proteins and identified proteins associated with immunoglobulin class-switching. In a cohort of patients with B cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma profiled by flow cytometry and CITE-seq, CytoVI uncovered disease-associated T cell states. CytoVI is available as open-source software at scvi-tools.org .

dropped.title: Spatiotemporal clonal architecture of the newborn mouse forebrain.
dropped.title_zh: 新生小鼠前脑的时空克隆结构。
dropped.summary_zh: 哺乳动物前脑的数百种细胞类型在发育过程中如何从有限的前体细胞集合中产生，仍然很大程度上未知1-3，而且迄今为止研究绝大多数集中在大脑皮层。在这里，为填补这一空白，我们在小鼠前脑的主要分区中应用慢病毒条形码：皮层、海马、纹状体、丘脑和嗅球。我们使用空间转录组学将细胞图谱与其解剖分布对应起来，创建了新生小鼠前脑克隆细胞谱系关系图谱。我们揭示了腹侧和背侧中型棘神经元生成中此前未被认识的差异，以及晚期出生中型棘神经元、纹状体星形胶质细胞和嗅球神经元不同亚群之间尚未探索的谱系关系。我们表明，具有广泛区域分布的GABA能（产生γ-氨基丁酸）神经元克隆富集与神经发育障碍相关基因。我们的结果突出了一条发育原则：谷氨酸能神经元和星形胶质细胞在克隆上相关并保留在其起源区域内，而GABA能神经元在克隆上与少突胶质前体细胞相关，但广泛分散于各脑区。总之，我们的发现将作为哺乳动物前脑发育及其疾病研究的基础参考。

extra.description: How hundreds of cell types of the mammalian forebrain emerge from a limited set of progenitor cells during development remains largely unknown1-3, and studies so far have overwhelmingly focused on the cerebral cortex. Here, to fill this gap, we applied lentiviral barcoding across the major subdivisions of the mouse forebrain: cortex, hippocampus, striatum, thalamus and olfactory bulb. We registered cellular profiles to their anatomical distribution using spatial transcriptomics, creating an atlas of clonal cell lineage relationships across a newborn mouse forebrain. We uncover previously unrecognized differences in generation of ventral and dorsal medium spiny neurons, as well as unexplored lineage relationships between late-born medium spiny neurons, striatal astrocytes and distinct subpopulations of the olfactory bulb neurons. We show that clones of GABAergic (γ-aminobutyric acid-producing) neurons with broad regional dispersion are enriched for genes implicated in neurodevelopmental disorders. Our results highlight a developmental principle whereby glutamatergic neurons and astrocytes are clonally related and retained within their region of origin, whereas GABAergic neurons are clonally related to oligodendrocyte precursor cells but disperse extensively across brain regions. Together, our findings will serve as a foundational reference for studies of mammalian forebrain development and its disorders.

longest_on_board.title: iPscDB: a comprehensive platform for plant single-cell transcriptomic data integration and analysis
longest_on_board.title_zh: iPscDB：植物单细胞转录组数据整合与分析的综合平台
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 摘要 单细胞技术的快速发展显著增强了我们研究植物组织内细胞异质性的能力。然而，解析这些复杂的细胞景观需要处理高维基因表达矩阵并整合多样数据集，以实现准确的标记选择、细胞鉴定和其他复杂计算操作。这些过程通常需要广泛的编程专业知识，对计算背景有限的研究人员构成挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了整合植物单细胞数据库（iPscDB），一个促进植物单细胞数据整合与分析的综合多功能平台。iPscDB结合了来自38个植物物种946个实验的4,688,428个细胞和288,139个精选细胞标记。在原始数据可用的地方，数据集通过单一统一流程重新处理，并对整合质量和自动细胞类型注释进行了定量基准测试。该平台引入了标记置信水平方案，根据支持证据的强度和独立性对每个细胞类型标记进行分级（从手动精选的经典标记到数据库衍生的关联），允许用户直接判断标记可靠性。该平台还提供用户友好的在线分析流程和模块，能够处理原始FAS

extra.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of single-cell technologies has significantly enhanced our ability to investigate cellular heterogeneity within plant tissues. However, deciphering these intricate cellular landscapes requires processing high-dimensional gene expression matrices and integrating diverse datasets to enable accurate marker selection, cell identification, and other complex computational operations. These processes typically require broad programming expertise, posing a challenge for researchers with a limited computational background. To address this, we present integrated Plant single-cell Database (iPscDB), an integrated and multifunctional platform that facilitates the integration and analysis of plant single-cell data. iPscDB combines 4 688 428 cells and 288 139 curated cell markers derived from 946 experiments across 38 plant species. Wherever raw data were available, datasets were reprocessed through a single uniform pipeline, and both integration quality and automated cell-type annotation were benchmarked quantitatively. The platform introduces a Marker Confidence Level scheme that grades each cell-type marker by the strength and independence of its supporting evidence (from manually curated classic markers to database-derived associations), allowing users to judge marker reliability directly. The platform also provides a user-friendly online analysis pipeline and modules capable of processing raw FASTQ files or Cell Ranger-processed files. Users can configure parameters via an intuitive interface and utilize an integrated image editor to customize visualization outputs. Additionally, iPscDB supports various analyses, including cross-species gene expression, electronic Single-Cell Pictograph, and developmental trajectory. By streamlining the complex workflows of single-cell transcriptomics, iPscDB offers a practical and accessible resource for researchers with diverse technical backgrounds. iPscDB is accessible at https://www.tobaccodb.org/ipscdb/homePage.

longest_on_board.summary_zh: 全球癌症发病率持续上升，许多肿瘤类型仍然难以有效治疗。虽然现有药物可以缓解症状或减缓疾病进展，但其疗效在患者之间差异很大。为了探索这一挑战，我们提出了一种计算方法来识别患者特异性候选化合物。我们的方法是为胶质母细胞瘤开发的，但可以应用于其他类型的癌症。我们的研究涉及识别可能对每位患者特异的疾病相关蛋白质，这些蛋白质是生成网络的基础，同时还包括药物靶点和与癌症依赖性相关的蛋白质。这些网络使用中心性度量和Louvain社区检测方法进行分析。然后，进一步研究个体网络，应用网络可控性分析来识别网络中的关键调控靶点。这些靶点经过过滤和排序，以优先筛选用于个体化治疗的候选药物。通过比较患者之间的结果以及与基于通用数据的网络，我们展示了患者特异性网络表示与通用网络表示之间的显著差异。此外，我们追踪了五个胶质母细胞瘤病例中患者特异性网络随时间的变化，探索原发肿瘤和复发肿瘤之间的分子差异如何影响网络结构和计

extra.description: The incidence of cancer continues to rise globally, with many tumor types remaining difficult to treat effectively. While existing drugs can alleviate symptoms or slow disease progression, their efficacy varies considerably between patients. To explore this challenge, we present a computational approach for identifying patient-specific candidate compounds. Our approach was developed for glioblastoma, but it can be applied to other types of cancer. Our study involves identifying possible disease-relevant proteins specific to each patient that underlie the generated networks, together with drug targets and proteins associated with cancer dependency. These networks are analyzed using centrality measures and Louvain community detection method. Then, further investigating the individual networks, network controllability analysis is applied to identify key regulatory targets within the network. These targets are filtered and ranked to prioritize candidate drugs for individualized treatment. By comparing results across patients and against networks based on generic data, we show substantial differences between patient-specific and generic network representations. Additionally, we track changes in patient-specific networks over time in five glioblastoma cases, exploring how molecular differences between primary and recurrent tumors may influence network structure and computational drug prioritization.

longest_on_board.title: CoMR: an integrative scoring pipeline for comprehensive mitochondrial proteome reconstruction across eukaryotes
longest_on_board.title_zh: CoMR：一个整合评分流程，用于真核生物线粒体蛋白质组的全面重建
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 摘要 从真核序列数据重建线粒体蛋白质组通常依赖预测线粒体靶向信号（MTS）。但MTS预测器主要基于模式生物训练，在系统发育差异大的谱系或靶向序列异常或缩短的生物中可能表现不佳。准确重建需要整合靶向预测之外的互补证据。我们开发了CoMR（综合线粒体重建器），一个整合流程，在统一评分框架中结合靶向预测、精选同源搜索、大规模相似性搜索和自动系统发育分析。在模式酵母酿酒酵母上基准测试，判别性能强（ROC-AUC=0.92），超过单独用TargetP2（N端靶向肽预测器，ROC-AUC=0.72）。在差异大的厌氧原生生物Paratrimastix pyriformis中，CoMR保持稳健性能（ROC-AUC=0.86），用实验蛋白质组验证，尽管类别极不平衡，精确率-召回率AUC为0.183（比随机预期高约78倍，比TargetP2好约10倍）。消融分析显示，预测性能对单层证据移除稳健，而重叠分析显示

extra.description: Abstract Mitochondrial proteome reconstruction from eukaryotic sequence data typically relies on prediction of mitochondrial targeting signals (MTSs). However, MTS predictors are primarily trained on model organisms and may perform poorly in phylogenetically divergent lineages or in organisms with atypical or reduced targeting sequences. Accurate reconstruction therefore requires integration of complementary sources of evidence beyond targeting prediction alone. We developed Comprehensive Mitochondrial Reconstructor (CoMR), an integrative workflow that combines targeting prediction, curated homology searches, large-scale similarity searches, and automated phylogenetic analysis within a unified scoring framework. Benchmarking on the model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae yielded strong discriminatory performance [receiver operating characteristic (ROC)-area under the curve (AUC) = 0.92], exceeding standalone prediction with TargetP2, a predictor of N-terminal targeting peptides (ROC-AUC = 0.72). In the divergent anaerobic protist Paratrimastix pyriformis, CoMR maintained robust performance (ROC-AUC = 0.86) validated with an experimental proteome despite extreme class imbalance, achieving a precision-recall AUC of 0.183 (~78-fold enrichment over random expectation and ~10-fold improvement over TargetP2). Ablation analyses demonstrate that predictive performance is robust to individual evidence-layer removal, while overlap analyses showed that homology-based searches recovered candidates missed by targeting predictors, particularly in P. pyriformis. Overall, CoMR improves mitochondrial proteome reconstruction over targeting prediction alone and provides a reproducible workflow for predicting mitochondrial and mitochondrion-related organelle protein repertoires across eukaryotes to aid investigations of organelle evolution and proteome reduction.
